title: Role-based access control
statement: The system shall deny 100% of operations not permitted by the requesting principal's roles, with privileges scoped to individual graphs.
rationale: SOC 2 / ISO 27001 access-control evidence; least-privilege built-in roles.

acceptance_criteria.text: A user granted read on graph A receives a permission error on any write to A and any read of graph B.
Built-in roles (reader, writer, admin, clusterAdmin) are documented with their exact privileges.

notes: Label-level privileges are a possible later refinement.
